Când detecția vede un om, se cere camere: When detection sees a person, a high-resolution frame is requested from the camera and faces are searched for. The same person usually scores 0.5-0.8; different people under 0.3 — the default threshold of 0.45 is a good balance. Lower threshold = recognizes more easily, but may mix people up; higher = stricter.
Când detecția vede un vehicul, se cere c: When detection sees a vehicle, a high-resolution frame is requested from the camera and the plates are read. Every read goes into the log below; to catch anything, the street-facing cameras must have AI detection turned on (🐾).
Când expiră retenția obișnuită, segmente: When regular retention expires, segments WITH events are moved here instead of being deleted (like an “Archive Vault”). The copy is verified by hash before it disappears from the main disk. Playback, export and coverage see them like any others.
